Thanks Rishi — reviewed the spreadsheet. Quick take from finance:
- Margin floor: we need a blended gross margin of at least 48% over the 12-month term to accept a collar that allows pass-through only beyond +/-15%. The modeling assumes 70% utilization and the current GPU spot runs as baseline.
- Discount cap: finance is comfortable with up to 18% discount at 40 slots inside the collar. Anything beyond 18% requires CRO approval.
- Outside collar: recommend a two-way pass-through with a 75% cap on the delta (i.e., we absorb 25% of the GPU cost increase as a partner concession; if costs decrease, we pass savings proportionally).
- Operational safeguard: require a quarterly review clause and the right to add a 30-day notice for material index changes.

If that aligns, I authorize Rishi to present the conditional 12-month term to the customer with: 40-slot commit, 18% inside-collar discount, two-way pass-through beyond +/-15% with a 75% absorption cap by Redwood, quarterly review.
